# Pre-port hydro history reference

`netcdf-c-history.nc` was generated on a Linux host by the pre-port static netCDF-C
4.9.3 `rw_nextgen_output` binary from lane/hydro-conus-route, using the exact
plan and payload generated by `complete_hydro_history_contract_and_reference_fixture`.
It is synthetic test data: three reaches (including i64::MAX), three frames,
four float fields, signed zero, and NC_STRING reach labels. No observations.
SHA-256: 09a81a719d71d884608975698a11ef589cdf352c5d23534c6343a49d0d1ebde5.

The crate test compares the complete ordered typed schema and every payload byte.
Set HYDRO_NETCDF_REFERENCE_FIXTURE to a new directory during cargo test to export
the plan, payload and candidate file. Run the old CLI's `request` operation on
that plan/payload to regenerate the reference. `tests/compare_history.py` checks
both files independently through netCDF-C (netCDF4-python) and h5py, including
HDF5 fill properties. Those Python packages are QA tools, never writer dependencies.
